# Core Bins, bin pop-up (census #51 Move C2, #52 Load C3) and Create bin's label check.
# static/pages/bins.js run as served over PAGE_NODES / PAGE_PAYLOADS = the fixture, its
# pickers on shared/node-picker.js and part-picker.js (rows: "value" | label · note (off: reason)).

== Create bin's Node (C1, census #50): mounted at load on #bin-create-node, rule: robot, disabled
  [ZONE-1]
    "1" | GRP-A · group
      "2" | GRP-A-L1 · lane
      "3" | ↳ GRP-A-L1-S1
      "4" | ↳ GRP-A-L1-S2
    "12" | OLD-SLOT  (off: disabled)
  [ZONE-2]
    "5" | GRP-B · group
      "6" | GRP-B-N1
      "7" | GRP-B-N2
    "14" | GRP-OFF · group  (off: disabled)
      "15" | GRP-OFF-N1
    "8" | LINE-1 · Line one
  [Other]
    "9" | SPOT-9
    "13" | VIRT-1 · synthetic
    "11" | _ROBOT:AMR-01 · robot  (off: a robot, not a place)
  the form posts it as: <input type="hidden" name="node_id"> value ""
  pick "8": node_id = "8"
  pick "10": not taken: not offered
  pick "11": not taken: offered greyed: a robot, not a place
  pick "12": not taken: offered greyed: disabled
  pick "": node_id = ""
census #11 fixed: _TRANSIT is not offered; the robot deck and the disabled OLD-SLOT and GRP-OFF
are greyed with their reason; groups and lanes stay (the server decides those).
== (end of Create bin)

== Load payload (C3): renderContents, per bin type (PAGE_PAYLOAD_BIN_TYPES greys)
  bin type 1:
    "PART-A" | PART-A · Part A
    "PART-B" | PART-B · Part B  (off: not on a TYPE-1)
    "PART-C" | PART-C · Part C
  bin type 2:
    "PART-A" | PART-A · Part A
    "PART-B" | PART-B · Part B
    "PART-C" | PART-C · Part C  (off: not on a TYPE-2)
  bin type 3:
    "PART-A" | PART-A · Part A
    "PART-B" | PART-B · Part B  (off: not on a TYPE-3)
    "PART-C" | PART-C · Part C  (off: not on a TYPE-3)
  held (load_refusal set): sentence shown: true, Load button disabled, rows:
    "PART-A" | PART-A · Part A  (off: Held by order 41 until it is delivered.)
    "PART-B" | PART-B · Part B  (off: Held by order 41 until it is delivered.)
    "PART-C" | PART-C · Part C  (off: Held by order 41 until it is delivered.)
  (no request)

== the body each pick sends (an answer of 200)
-- Move to LINE-1
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
-- Move, nothing picked
  (no request)
  toast info: Select a destination
-- Move to where it is
  (no request)
  toast info: Bin is already at this location
-- Request Move to GRP-B-N1 (the detail re-reads never answer here)
  POST /api/bins/request-move {"bin_id":50,"destination_node_id":6}
  GET /api/bins/detail?id=50&history=0
  GET /api/bins/detail?id=50&history=0
  toast info: Move #41 to GRP-B-N1 requested (queued): the lane is busy
-- Load PART-A, count blank
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"load_payload","params":{"payload_code":"PART-A"}}
-- Load PART-A, count 0
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"load_payload","params":{"payload_code":"PART-A","uop_override":0}}
-- Load, nothing picked
  (no request)
  toast info: Select a payload

== refusals: Move to LINE-1
-- json.400: 400 "{\"error\":\"refused: the service's sentence\"}"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: refused: the service's sentence
-- auth.401: 401 "{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error (sticky): Signed out
  toast error: Error: Signed out
-- json.500: 500 "{\"error\":\"failed: the store's error\"}"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: failed: the store's error
-- proxy.502: 502 "<html><body>502 Bad Gateway</body></html>"
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: Server error (502)
-- fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
  POST /api/bins/action {"id":50,"action":"move","params":{"node_id":8}}
  toast error: Error: No answer from the server

== refusals: Request Move to GRP-B-N1
-- json.409: 409 "{\"error\":\"refused: the service's sentence\"}"
  POST /api/bins/request-move {"bin_id":50,"destination_node_id":6}
  toast error: Error: refused: the service's sentence
-- fetch rejects (TypeError: Failed to fetch)
  POST /api/bins/request-move {"bin_id":50,"destination_node_id":6}
  toast error: Error: No answer from the server
